"""Build the text message customers get when their order ships."""

SMS_LIMIT = 160  # characters in one SMS


def shipping_message(order):
    """order: dict with name, number, address and eta (e.g. 'Thu 12 Mar')."""
    head = f"Hi {order['name']}, order #{order['number']} has shipped to "
    tail = f". Expected {order['eta']}. Reply STOP to opt out."
    address = order["address"]
    room = SMS_LIMIT - len(head) - len(tail)
    if len(address) > room:
        address = address[: room - 3].rstrip(" ,") + "..."
    return head + address + tail


def messages_for(orders):
    """Messages for the orders that have a phone number."""
    return [(o["phone"], shipping_message(o)) for o in orders if o.get("phone")]

"""Pull lines out of an app log by level: python logscan.py app.log WARNING"""
import sys

LEVELS = ["DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR", "CRITICAL"]  # least to most serious


def line_level(line):
    """Lines look like '2026-03-01 12:00:01 WARNING disk at 91%'."""
    parts = line.split(maxsplit=3)
    return parts[2] if len(parts) >= 3 and parts[2] in LEVELS else None


def filter_lines(lines, level):
    level = level.upper()
    if level not in LEVELS:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown level {level}")
    floor = LEVELS.index(level)
    return [
        line for line in lines
        if line_level(line) is not None and LEVELS.index(line_level(line)) >= floor
    ]


def main(argv):
    path, level = argv
    with open(path) as fh:
        for line in filter_lines(fh.read().splitlines(), level):
            print(line)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

"""Build the morning digest shown on the office screen."""

MAX_ITEMS = 10  # what fits on the screen


def build_digest(items):
    """items: dicts with 'title', 'posted' (ISO time) and 'urgent' (True/False).

    Returns the titles to show, newest first.
    """
    newest = sorted(items, key=lambda i: i["posted"], reverse=True)
    urgent = [i for i in newest if i["urgent"]]
    routine = [i for i in newest if not i["urgent"]]
    room = max(0, MAX_ITEMS - len(urgent))
    chosen = urgent + routine[:room]
    chosen.sort(key=lambda i: i["posted"], reverse=True)
    return [i["title"] for i in chosen]


def render(titles):
    return "\n".join(f"{n}. {t}" for n, t in enumerate(titles, 1))

"""Build the mailing list for the club newsletter from members.csv."""
import csv
from datetime import date, timedelta


def load_members(path="members.csv"):
    """Columns: email, name, status (paid or lapsed), last_opened (YYYY-MM-DD, blank if never)."""
    members = []
    with open(path, newline="") as fh:
        for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
            opened = row["last_opened"].strip()
            row["last_opened"] = date.fromisoformat(opened) if opened else None
            members.append(row)
    return members


INACTIVE_AFTER = timedelta(days=180)


def is_active(member, today):
    last = member["last_opened"]
    return last is not None and today - last < INACTIVE_AFTER


def mailing_list(members, today=None):
    """Email addresses to send this month's newsletter to (inactive readers are left out)."""
    today = today or date.today()
    return [m["email"] for m in members if is_active(m, today)]

"""Clean up temperature logs from the greenhouse sensors (see docs/sensor.txt)."""

MISSING = -999.0


def parse_log(text):
    """Lines look like 'HH:MM,value'. Returns a list of (time, float)."""
    out = []
    for line in text.strip().splitlines():
        time, value = line.split(",")
        out.append((time.strip(), float(value)))
    return out


def daily_stats(readings):
    values = [v for _, v in readings if v != MISSING]
    return {
        "min": min(values),
        "max": max(values),
        "mean": round(sum(values) / len(values), 2),
        "count": len(values),
    }

"""Write the weekly stock report to a text file."""
import os
from datetime import date


def render(stock, day):
    lines = [f"Stock report for week of {day.isoformat()}", ""]
    for item, qty in sorted(stock.items()):
        flag = "  LOW" if qty < 5 else ""
        lines.append(f"{item:<12}{qty:>5}{flag}")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


MARKER = "--- report below ---"


def write_report(path, stock, day=None):
    """Replace the report, keeping everything down to and including the MARKER line."""
    day = day or date.today()
    keep = ""
    if os.path.exists(path):
        with open(path) as fh:
            text = fh.read()
        at = text.find(MARKER)
        if at >= 0:
            end = text.find("\n", at)
            keep = text[: end + 1] if end >= 0 else text + "\n"
    with open(path, "w") as fh:
        fh.write(keep + render(stock, day))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    write_report(os.environ.get("REPORT_FILE", "stock_report.txt"), {"tins": 12, "lids": 3})

"""Make URL slugs for blog post titles."""
import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title, max_len=60):
    """Lower-case ASCII letters, digits and single hyphens only: "Hello, World!" -> "hello-world".

    Accented letters are written without their accents ("Café" -> "cafe").
    """
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    text = text.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii").lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")
    return text[:max_len].rstrip("-")


def post_url(title, year):
    return f"/blog/{year}/{slugify(title)}/"
